note: CB-h: tree-sitter-typescript puts a method's decorators BESIDE its method_definition in class_body, so the TypeScript parser's POSITION span for onShipped starts at the name line, not at `@OnEvent(...)`. The A5.8 anchor pass finds no method span holding the decorator line and falls back to the module CONTAINS edge. Measured on HEAD 2170ff8: CONTAINS src::orders.gateway -> event_handle:order.shipped, `[marker-anchor] 1 anchored to methods, 2 to module`. The graphql root noun `Query` is type-level and keeps its module CONTAINS (control).

expect_edges.note: control: a root noun stays on the module

expect_cells.note: 0-based row of the first decorator; HEAD writes 9 (the name line)

forbid.note: a root noun never lands on the first decorated method
